meta.name: IO MLflow Sink
meta.description: Routes xOpat data into MLflow experiments and runs through the IO pipeline. Admin-routable via ENV.client.io.bindings; the record layout is chosen from named templates or a custom mapper. The MLflow credential is held server-side by a proxy alias and never reaches the client.

template.custom: A custom mapper registered at runtime.

error.auth: MLflow rejected the credential. Check the server-side token's validity and the proxy's auth verifier chain.
error.notFound: The MLflow experiment or run was not found. Check the experiment template and the proxy's upstream URL.
error.http: MLflow could not be reached. Check that the server proxy alias is configured and the MLflow host is up.
error.httpStatus: MLflow refused the request (HTTP {{status}}). Check the proxy alias's upstream URL and the MLflow server's log.
error.experimentDenied: Writing to the MLflow experiment "{{experiment}}" is not permitted by this deployment.
error.runDenied: Writing to the MLflow run "{{run}}" is not permitted by this deployment.
error.artifactDenied: The MLflow artifact path "{{path}}" is outside the location this deployment permits.
error.mapperMissing: No MLflow record template named "{{name}}" exists.
error.mapperThrew: The MLflow record template "{{name}}" failed on this record.
error.mapperShape: The MLflow record template "{{name}}" produced an unusable result.
error.noArtifacts: This MLflow template writes artifacts, but no artifacts adapter is configured for the sink.
error.notConfigured: MLflow storage is not configured (no proxy alias or base URL).
error.targetMissing: MLflow storage is on for this session, but no usable MLflow experiment was selected. Set params.ioSinks.mlflow.target in the session.
error.targetUnbounded: This deployment lets sessions choose the MLflow experiment but does not limit which ones, so the choice is ignored. Ask the administrator to set experimentAllow.

consent.description: A script wants to change how scored data is written to MLflow.
consent.rejected: The MLflow structure change was canceled by the user.
consent.allowlistNote: Experiments and runs outside the deployment's allowlist are still refused.

setTemplate.title: Change the MLflow record structure
setTemplate.scope: Records written from now on use the new layout; already-written runs are untouched.

registerMapper.title: Use a custom MLflow record structure
registerMapper.detail: A script-supplied mapper named "{{name}}" will shape every record written to MLflow.

setTarget.title: Change where data is written in MLflow
setTarget.runFromTemplate: Run: chosen by the record structure
setTarget.notHonoured: Warning: this deployment's default storage settings ignore a session-chosen destination, so data may still go where the record structure decides.
